why_agent_cannot: confirm the domain against the project's own profile before touching it (forensics flags it)
what_human_must_do: Do not touch it: the domain check flagged it. Verify from the project's own X profile.
where_to_resume: python tools/triage.py https://www.swanusd.com/airdrop   # then re-run bulk_apply
steps_from_source: Open swanusd.com/airdrop from a link you typed yourself and enter your Ethereum address in the checker. If it is not listed, it cannot qualify for the launch pool.
Stake a little over 1,000 swanUSD to get at least 1,000 sSwanUSD.
Optionally deposit the sSwanUSD in SWAN-rewards staking. It still counts for the airdrop and also earns SWAN emissions.
Keep at least 1,000 sSwanUSD for 7 full days. Start no later than 12 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.
Watch @MonolithMarket for the claim date, then claim before the expiry. Monolith says it never sends DMs first, so ignore anyone who messages you with a claim link.
